text: Target K is the desired number of clusters at the end. Capacity is a hard upper limit on the total size inside each cluster. With capacity two, two unit-size cells fit together, but a third cell does not. A small cutsize does not make an oversized cluster legal. We must report whether the algorithm actually reaches K while respecting capacity.

cues.en: Target K is the desired number of clusters at the end.
cues.zh: 目标 K 表示最终期望得到的簇数。

cues.en: Capacity is a hard upper limit on the total size inside each cluster.
cues.zh: 容量是每个簇内总大小不可超过的上限。

cues.en: With capacity two, two unit-size cells fit together, but a third cell does not.
cues.zh: 容量为二时，两个大小为一的单元可以合并，但不能再加入第三个。

cues.en: A small cutsize does not make an oversized cluster legal.
cues.zh: 割边权重总和较小，并不能让超容量的簇变得合法。

cues.en: We must report whether the algorithm actually reaches K while respecting capacity.
cues.zh: 我们必须报告算法在遵守容量约束的同时，是否真的达到目标 K。
